parameter_refs.name: street_class
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: designated truck route or non-truck connecting street

parameter_refs.name: route_use
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: complete through passage or local destination

parameter_refs.name: enroute_purpose
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: none, pick-up, delivery or essential use required enroute

quote: Streets, other than truck routes, shall not be used as through routes from one truck route to another unless pick-up, delivery or essential use is required enroute.

activation.condition: Original motor-vehicle path enters a non-truck street from one designated truck route and reaches another designated truck route.

exceptions.description: pick-up required enroute; independent trip-purpose, premises and activity evidence needed.
delivery required enroute; independent trip-purpose, premises and activity evidence needed.
essential use required enroute; independent trip-purpose, premises and activity evidence needed.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Authoritative route designations, complete passage, and pick-up, delivery or essential use required enroute require independent original-source review; no stop-duration proxy or worker legal verdict.

obligation.description: Streets, other than truck routes, shall not be used as through routes from one truck route to another unless pick-up, delivery or essential use is required enroute.

timing.description: Observe the complete original route, not an isolated stop or 45-second startup transient.
